title: DuplicateGroup
description: A generated grouping of candidates sharing an EXACT_DUPLICATE or POSSIBLE_NEAR_DUPLICATE relationship, produced by scripts/trader_intelligence/detect_duplicates.py. Never deletes a member; canonicalCandidateId may be automatically populated only when every member's duplicateStatus is EXACT_DUPLICATE (URL/platform-ID/content-hash identity) -- any group containing a POSSIBLE_NEAR_DUPLICATE member requires an OwnerDecision before canonicalCandidateId may be set.

matchBasis.description: What matched. The first three are exact-duplicate bases; the remaining four are near-duplicate heuristics only.
